title: Reconcile Work Item roadmap status with archived lifecycle evidence

rawRequestSource.reference: User-authorized continuation of the full remediation and Work Item lifecycle.

authorizedExternalEffects: Create and update the Work Item PR for this documentation-only change.

problemStatement: The roadmap currently reports four completed Work Items and twenty-four unfinished candidates, while the authoritative archive index contains the completed core and Weekly Radar Work Items through wi-wr-016-runtime. This stale status can mislead planning and makes the repository's evidence-backed lifecycle state inconsistent with its navigation document.
outOfScope: Changing archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, or manifest contents
Changing the roadmap's product goals, architecture, or execution order beyond evidence-backed status reconciliation
Provider operations, credentials, Telegram, SEC, GitHub data, or production data-branch writes
Changing the AI Cockpit check implementations or weakening any quality gate

sources.reason: Repository governance requires a scoped Contract, evidence-backed Summary, full lifecycle, and no changes outside scope.
Defines Evidence over Self-Declaration and the Preflight Pause Rule used for this documentation correction.
Authoritative archive discovery index for completed Work Item identities, archive paths, and lifecycle evidence.
The stale roadmap status table and candidate sections are the documentation surface being reconciled.
Latest archived Weekly Radar runtime Contract establishes the current completed boundary.
Defines the required lifecycle and quality gates used to verify this Work Item.
Confirms the dedicated Work Item worktree and final cleanup state.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare the edited status table and completed/candidate sections against archive/index.json and the archived Contract filenames.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The only product documentation change is the roadmap plus the scoped plan and generated governance evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run scope, diff ownership, diff check, and inspect the final PR diff against the declared out-of-scope paths.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the canonical lifecycle commands, hosted checks, merge, close, and final local/remote state inspection.

riskAssessment.reason: A stale roadmap can misdirect future implementation sequencing, but the correction is narrow and is constrained to evidence-backed status text. Archived records remain immutable.
riskAssessment.destructiveChangeReview: No repository files are deleted; status text is corrected from the archive index.

reasons: The change is documentation-only; archive immutability and lifecycle evidence remain explicit Contract constraints.

executionDecision.reason: Scope, acceptance, sources, verification, and scenario evidence are sufficient for a documentation-only correction.

preReviewWarnings: Do not infer completion from roadmap text alone; derive completed status from archived Contract/Summary/Outcome evidence.
Do not rewrite archived Work Item records while reconciling the roadmap.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record the evidence boundary before editing and before final status generation.

acceptance: The roadmap status/count section is corrected to match the Work Items present in .ai/work-items/archive/index.json as of this Work Item.
Completed and planned/gated sections distinguish archived Work Items from genuinely uncreated candidates without changing product scope or execution order.
The roadmap records that archive/index.json is the lifecycle authority and includes the current no-active-Work-Item state.
The diff contains no implementation, test, dependency, workflow, evidence-record, or archived-Work-Item changes outside declared governance documentation.
The Summary and full AI Cockpit lifecycle provide evidence for scope, quality, PR, merge, close, and final clean-state verification.
guidelines: Keep roadmap status evidence-backed by the authoritative archive index.
Do not hand-edit generated current_status.md; regenerate it through Make targets.
Do not modify archived Work Item records while reconciling navigation documentation.

intent.problem: The roadmap's status table and counts lag behind the repository's archived Work Item lifecycle, so future planning can treat completed engineering as still pending.
constraints: Use archived Contract/Summary/Outcome/index evidence as the source of truth; do not invent completion state.
Keep the correction documentation-only except for required active/generated governance evidence.
Preserve the roadmap's domain boundaries and dependency order; update only status and evidence references.
Complete the same full Work Item lifecycle as implementation changes.
intent.rationale: Synchronizing the navigation document with immutable lifecycle evidence prevents planning drift without changing product behavior or archived history.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized all corresponding Work Items, self-check and correction loops, full lifecycle execution, and recording authorization in each Contract.

rollbackNote: Revert the roadmap-only commit; archived Work Item records remain unchanged.
